name: Hase Kujiki
source:
A perverted novelist and [url=/c60675]Nayuta's[/url] best friend. His dream is to become famous and for people to become more tolerant of lolicons. 

[Spoiler]In reality, he's just [url=/c56942]Tsurushi Urana's[/url] second personality, and the real Hase died from an illness when he was still a child.[/spoiler]
